name: Pinterest Paul
cadence: on request (Run now with a blog post link, or a Drive order naming Paul)

sources.label: the keyword map (which page owns which search)

does: Takes any of our blog posts and turns it into one Pinterest pin
Picks the single best photo from the post itself, and writes the keyword-led title, description and alt text
Picks the right board from our Pinterest boards
Once Katherine approves the card, pins it live; the pin links back to the post

traits.cant: Pin anything that has not been approved
traits.instead: Shows the pin on the Review tab exactly as it will go up; Approve pins it

traits.cant: Use a photo that is not in the post, or link anywhere but our own sites
traits.instead: The Box checks the photo and the link against the post it read before pinning

traits.cant: Edit or delete a pin, or change a board
traits.instead: Only adds new pins; changes are made in Pinterest by a person

needs: Katherine to connect our Pinterest business account to the Box once (a Pinterest app and a login approval)
